name: How long does it take to replace all the windows in a house?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace all the windows in a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for replacing all windows in a house varies based on the number of windows, their type, the complexity of the installation, and the crew size. For a typical Bay Area home with 10-15 windows, the process usually takes 2-5 days. Larger homes or those requiring significant frame repairs might take longer. Our project managers provide a detailed timeline after the initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing all windows in a house typically takes 2-5 days for a standard home, depending on the number and type of windows.
